HowItWorks.body: Simple enough for a toddler's nap-time. Polished enough to frame.

steps.title: Your roster
steps.body: Upload reference photos of the adults, children, and selected pets. We use them as visual guides so each portrait stays close to the people you love.

steps.title: Pick a vibe
steps.body: Choose a theme such as Golden Hour Beach, an autumn cabin, a studio portrait, or an animated family. You choose the feeling; we handle the rest.

steps.title: Yours to keep
steps.body: Rate the images with thumbs up or down, refine anything that is not quite right, then print, frame, or add the result to a card.

pillars.title: Only for your shoot
pillars.body: Your uploads are used to create the portraits, cards, refinements, and downloads you request. We do not use them to train FamilyShoot.

pillars.title: Easy to remove
pillars.body: You can delete reference photos and finished images from your studio wherever the app offers a delete action.

pillars.title: Not stored forever
pillars.body: Images remain available for 14 days on one-time packs or 90 days on Pro. Inactive accounts with no shoots left may be cleared after a reminder email.

Faq.title: A few careful details before you start.

items.question: What is an AI family photo generator?
items.answer: It creates a finished family portrait from everyday photos you already have. FamilyShoot uses your uploads as visual references, then turns them into a polished portrait, illustration, or card.

items.question: Can I make a family portrait from separate photos?
items.answer: Yes. Upload separate photos of each person, child, or selected pet, and FamilyShoot combines them into one natural family portrait.

items.question: Why do some images not look exactly like us?
items.answer: AI creates a new picture instead of copying faces. Clear, front-facing reference photos with shoulders or full body visible produce the best likeness.

items.question: What kind of reference photo works best?
items.answer: Use a clear, well-lit photo facing the camera with at least the shoulders visible. Full-body photos also help with height, build, and posture.

items.question: Can I add a pet or someone missing from the original photo?
items.answer: Yes. Add them to your roster with their own reference photos, then include them in the shoot.

items.question: Can I make holiday or Christmas cards?
items.answer: Yes. FamilyShoot includes styles for Christmas, Hanukkah, Diwali, Eid, Lunar New Year, Easter, birthdays, new babies, graduations, and more.

items.question: Do I pay before seeing the result?
items.answer: No. Create a watermarked preview first and pay only if you want the high-resolution files.

items.question: Can I try it for free?
items.answer: Yes. Your first shoot can be created as a watermarked preview. Buy credits only if you want to unlock it.

items.question: Can I buy FamilyShoot credits as a gift?
items.answer: Yes. Choose Buy as gift on a one-time pack and receive a private gift code and redeem link.

items.question: Do you email the gift code to the recipient?
items.answer: Not automatically. The buyer copies the code or link and shares it directly by text, email, or card.

items.question: How does someone redeem a gift code?
items.answer: They sign in, open the redeem link or enter the code on the Gift credits page, and the shoots are added to their account.

items.question: Can I get a refund after a shoot is created?
items.answer: Paid shoots cannot be refunded after generation has run. If something breaks or the shoot fails, contact us and we will help.

items.question: How long are my photos stored?
items.answer: Photos are kept for 14 days on one-time packs and 90 days on FamilyShoot Pro.

items.question: What happens to inactive accounts?
items.answer: Accounts with no shoots left may be removed after 30 inactive days. We send a reminder first.

items.question: Do you use my photos to train AI models?
items.answer: We do not use your photos to train FamilyShoot. They are processed only to create the images and downloads you request.

items.question: Can I delete something sooner?
items.answer: Yes. You can remove reference photos and finished images wherever the studio offers a delete action.
